1283-1651-2557-6753-8276.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Hive by paying {5} and tapping it, creating four 1/1 Wasp artifact creature tokens due to Parallel Lives and Exalted Sunborn.

1283-1651-2557-6753-8276.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.

443-4279-7286--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
443-4279-7286--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, South Wind Avatar, Magus of the Bridge and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Magus of the Bridge ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, South Wind Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

When the creature dies, Vindictive Vampire and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

3899-5170-6132-7574.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Sultai Flayer triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Sultai Flayer trigger.
Resolve the Sultai Flayer trigger, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

Repeat.

2034-4559-5805-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gev.

When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.

At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.

Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Roaring Earth
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 5.

Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.

Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Mogg Fanatic ability.
Cast Mogg Fanatic from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

6709-6867-6869.description:

Appa triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.

Repeat.

Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Coercive Recruiter
1812-2440-2534-4183.description:

Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

224-736-5196.notablePrerequisites:
At least one basic land in hand.
Copy Enchantment is a copy of Retreat to Coralhelm.
Murasa Rootgrazer does not have summoning sickness.

Activate Murasa Rootgrazer's first ability, putting a basic land from your hand onto the battlefield.
The Retreat to Coralhelms trigger.
In response, activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Let the first Retreat to Coralhelm trigger resolve, untapping Murasa Rootgrazer.
Activate Murasa Rootgrazer's last ability, returning any basic land you control from the battlefield to your hand.
Let the second Retreat trigger resolve, untapping Murasa Rootgrazer.
Repeat.

An opponent controls an indestructible creature, or you have a way to give an opponent's creature indestructible.

851-1527-4911.description:

Once you have infinite creature tokens, you may activate Wildwood Mentor using Thopter Squadron's last ability any number of times.

Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}.

Resolve the copy of Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}{R}.
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R} and sacrificing Ruthless Technomancer.
Activate Cursed Mirror by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing two Treasures, returning Ruthless Technomancer from your graveyard to the battelfield.
When Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Dargo and create seven Treasure tokens.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}{R}.
Repeat from step ?.

Move to your next turn.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the Pull from Eternity copy, putting Rise of the Eldrazi into your graveyard from exile.
Repeat.

974-2472-2871.notablePrerequisites: There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
974-2472-2871.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token, and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {3}{R}, targeting any creature you control.
Song of the Worldsoul triggers, creating a copy of the Smaug token.
Put a Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Smaug dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Resolve Seething Anger, giving a creature you control +3/+0 until end of turn and returning Seething Anger to your hand.
Activate four Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite colored mana, you may use Song of the Worldsoul's trigger to target any other token you control instead.

4050-5003-5050.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents.
4050-5003-5050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Chittering Witch, adding {1}.
Chittering Witch dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Chittering Witch from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Chittering Witch enters the battlefield, creating at least three 1/1 Rat creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Rats, adding {3}.
Repeat.

44-1295-1368-1908-5195.notablePrerequisites:
You have cast at least one instant or sorcery this turn.
You have at least three other cards in your graveyard if Maestros Charm is in your graveyard.
44-1295-1368-1908-5195.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Rionya triggers, creating at least two token copies of Storm-Kiln Artist.
Move to your post-combat main phase.
If Maestros Charm is in your hand, cast it by paying {U}{B}{R}.
Otherwise, cast it from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {U}{B}{R} and exiling three cards from your graveyard, ensuring not to exile Thassa's Oracle if it is in your graveyard.
Each Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Resolve Maestros Charm, causing you to look at the top five cards of your library, put one of them in your hand and put the rest into your graveyard.
If you don't have an empty library, activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{B}{R}.
Repeat from step 3 until you have an empty library.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
If Thassa's Oracle is in your hand, cast it by paying {U}{U}.
Otherwise, cast it for its escape cost by paying {U}{U} and exiling three cards from your graveyard.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, causing you to win the game.

Activate Thopter Squadron second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing a Thopter, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.

Repeat.

Roar of the Kha is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
